1. The Service

HamaraSetu is a platform that connects customers with local kirana shops and delivery partners. We facilitate ordering and delivery; we do not own the shops or directly employ the delivery partners. Each shop is responsible for the quality and accuracy of its inventory.

2. Account registration

You must register with a valid phone number to place orders. You are responsible for keeping your account secure. You agree to provide accurate information and update it when needed. You must be at least 18 years old to create an account.

3. Placing orders

When you place an order, you are entering into a contract with the shop you ordered from, with HamaraSetu acting as an intermediary. The shop is responsible for fulfilling your order. Prices, availability, and delivery fees are shown before you confirm the order.

4. Payment

You can pay by Cash on Delivery or through online methods (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets) processed by Razorpay. By paying online, you agree to Razorpay's terms at razorpay.com/terms. We do not store your card or bank details.

5. Delivery

Delivery times are estimates, not guarantees. We aim for under 30 minutes in our service area, but actual times depend on shop preparation time, distance, weather, and traffic. See our Shipping & Delivery Policy for full details.

6. Cancellations and refunds

You can cancel an order before the shop accepts it, free of charge. Once a shop has accepted and started preparing, cancellation is subject to our Refund & Cancellation Policy.

You may rate shops and delivery partners after an order is delivered. Your ratings help other customers and improve the Service. You agree not to submit false, misleading, or abusive reviews. We may moderate or remove reviews that violate these terms.
